title: Golden Layers and Where to Find Them: Improved Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models Via Layer Gradient Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2602.20207v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge editing in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to update the model's prediction for a specific query to a desired target while preserving its behavior on all other inputs. This process typically involves two stages: identifying the layer to edit and performing the parameter update. Intuitively, different queries may localize knowledge at different depths of the model, resulting in different sample-wise editing performance for a fixed editing layer. In this work, we hypothesize the existence of fixed golden layers that can achieve near-optimal editing performance similar to sample-wise optimal layers. To validate this hypothesis, we provide empirical evidence by comparing golden layers against ground-truth sample-wise optimal layers. translated_title: 黄金层及其寻找之道：通过层梯度分析改进大语言模型的知识编辑
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）中的知识编辑旨在将模型对特定查询的预测更新为期望的目标，同时保持模型对所有其他输入的原有行为。这一过程通常包含两个阶段：确定需要编辑的层，以及执行参数更新。直觉上，不同的查询可能会将知识定位于模型的不同深度，因此固定的编辑层对不同样本的编辑性能会有所差异。在本工作中，我们假设存在固定的“黄金层”，能够达到与逐样本最优层相近的近最优编辑性能。为验证这一假设，我们通过将黄金层与真实的逐样本最优层进行对比，提供了实证证据。此外，我们证明黄金层可以通过代理数据集被可靠地识别出来，并且能够有效地泛化到不同数据集中未见过的测试集查询上。最后，我们提出了一种新颖的方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过层梯度分析，证明了大语言模型中存在固定的“黄金层”，其知识编辑性能接近逐样本最优层，且这些黄金层可通过代理数据集可靠识别并能跨数据集泛化到未见查询，从而改进了知识编辑方法。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates through layer gradient analysis that fixed "golden layers" exist in LLMs, achieving near-optimal knowledge editing performance comparable to sample-wise optimal layers, and these layers can be reliably identified via proxy datasets and generalize to unseen queries across datasets, thereby improving knowledge editing methods.
